text:
Gwen: Quick capture from DeepCare pilot review 14 their AP team can't reconcile charges to product routes. They asked for a downloadable per-route ledger (CSV) and an explanation of how we compute unit_price rounding. Said this is blocking a broader rollout.

Harold: Ack. Do we have their AP template or a sample invoice?

Gwen: Uploaded to the intake doc: https://redwood.internal/cs/deepcare_intake. They require columns: client_ref, team_label, route_tag, iso_ts, tokens, model, unit_price_usd, line_cost_usd, invoice_ref.

Sanjay: Short triage: severity = renewal risk (P0), accounts impacted = 1 pilot with expansion on hold, reproducible = yes (sample invoice provided). Recommend immediate backfill + mapping doc for finance.

Molly: Technical check 14 do logs include route_tag today? If yes we can generate a backfill CSV quickly; otherwise we need a small mapping pass to infer route from request_path.

Harold: I inspected logs earlier 14 route is present as freeform route_name but not normalized. Backfill doable in ~48h; persistent fix (store normalized route_tag on ingest) ~5d.

Gwen: Customer accepts a backfill as interim. They're asking for a short-term CSV plus a permanent roadmap item. Also requested a "finance-impact" flag on intake so CS can surface high-risk asks to Product.

CSBot: Ticket created -> DC-1102: "DeepCare per-route ledger export + finance-impact intake" assigned to @Harold.

Sanjay: Proposed action plan:
- Deliver backfill CSV with checksum and rounding notes (48-72h)
- Ship intake field "finance-impact" + guidance doc (48h)
- Add persistent ingest change to backlog for normalized route_tag (P1, sprint 2)

Molly: I'll draft a minimal CSV header and include an "inferred_route" boolean for fuzzy mappings:
```
client_ref,team_label,route_tag,inferred_route,iso_ts,tokens,model,unit_price_usd,line_cost_usd,invoice_ref
```

Harold: I'll scope the backfill today. If we hit >5% of rows missing a clear route mapping we'll surface that to CS and include a reconciliation appendix.

Gwen: I'll assemble the finance-facing explanation: rounding policy, timezone normalization, and a small verification checklist for AP to run.

Sanjay: For prioritization: adding "finance-impact" to intake lets Product filter on ARR exposure and renewal risk. Suggest boolean + estimated ARR field.

Molly: Agree. Intake change is small and will make routing to Product easier.

CSBot: Reminder scheduled -> follow-up DC-1102 in 3 days.

Harold: Action items recap:
- Harold: run backfill + upload CSV to intake (48-72h)
- Molly: add inferred_route flag and prototype CSV header in ticket (today)
- Gwen: finance explanation doc + verification checklist (48h)
- Sanyaj: update intake template with finance-impact + arr_estimate fields (48h)

Gwen: Thanks team 14 I'll notify DeepCare finance that we'll deliver an interim CSV within 72h and schedule a validation session after delivery.

Harold: Starting the backfill spike tonight; will post any blockers here.

Sanjay: Nice triage. Please mark the account health as "at-risk" until CSV validated.

Gwen: Will do. Adding this to the weekly CS->Product rollup once backfill done.
